lines.text: David appointed stonecutters from the foreigners and gathered iron, bronze, and cedar logs brought by the Sidonians and Tyrians.
David called Solomon, whom he described as young and inexperienced, and told him to build a house for the LORD.
David said the LORD forbade him to build because of his bloodshed, and Solomon's reign would bring Israel great riches.
David prayed that Solomon would gain insight to keep the Law given to Aaron, and listed 100,000 talents of gold.
David ordered Israel's leaders to help Solomon and seek the LORD, so the ark could enter the temple.
